review_protocol.criterion: Observable active abnormal episode; short pauses in continuing confrontation retained; static aftermath excluded, except ongoing visible fire/smoke
review_protocol.normal: All frames outside annotated episodes; existing title cards are retained and can make some negatives easy
review_protocol.selection_bias: Short-video and visually clear-event selection; not representative of all long/ambiguous validation videos
review_protocol.final_count_reason: 22 reviewed current-validation videos retained; initial stale-metadata split drafts rejected before upload or model selection, then supplemented using authoritative split.
review_protocol.uncertainty: Approximate observable-event intervals; original annotator uncertainty retained, replay footage and edited camera views remain on displayed video timeline
review_protocol.new_annotation_author: Gemini4 Hydrogen High via agy native read_file(video/mp4), native image overviews, 2fps boundary refinement
review_protocol.new_annotation_reviewer: Codex visual review, not a second independent human annotator
review_protocol.native_tool_sampling: approximately1fps; original timeline2fps boundary evidence reviewed separately
review_protocol.large_video_exception: Fighting004 original exceeds100MB: full-duration remote CPU8fps/640px H264 preview; original source SHA and derived preview SHA recorded; no local video disk cache
